description: Count inclusive calendar days per country and calendar year, deduplicate overlapping trips, and report each country's maximum in any rolling 365-day window. Use this general travel log for country-presence tracking; use calculate_feie_days for the US tax test. Each entry is Country|arrival|departure.

entries.description: Trips as Country|YYYY-MM-DD|YYYY-MM-DD; arrival and departure both count.

limit.description: Your comparison threshold in days. Defaults to 183.

name: count_travel_days
title: Count travel days by country
